message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in smaller white font. The top section contains two text boxes with Indonesian headlines and page numbers: "Bukti Baru Korupsi Timah Bangka Belitung H.72" and "Centang-Perenang Aturan Barang Impor H.84".

The central image depicts a large, light-colored classical structure resembling a Greek temple, labeled "MAHKAMAH KON" on its architrave. The building is in a state of ruin; several of its fluted columns are broken and lying in pieces in the foreground, while others are partially standing or cracked. On the roof's edge, three small figures wearing long red and black robes sit or stand. One figure sits with legs dangling over the edge, while the other two stand nearby.

In the lower left, the text "PUTUSAN MAHKAMAH BERMASALAH" is written in large, bold black letters, followed by a smaller paragraph of Indonesian text. The bottom right corner displays a barcode, a QR code, the date "29 APRIL-5 MEI 2024," and pricing information. The background shows a pale blue sky.
